properties.displayName: UAV S105 - Sybil Member Injection into Swarm
properties.description: UAVSwarmComms_CL의 member_roster 메시지에서 MemberCountObserved가 MemberCountExpected를 초과하거나, UnknownMemberIds 중 Approved_SystemId_List에 등록되지 않은 진짜 미확인 멤버(TrulyUnknownMembers)가 존재하는 Sybil 위장 멤버 주입 탐지. MITRE: T0859 Valid Accounts (ICS — description 참조)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let KnownSystemIdsArr = toscalar(_GetWatchlist('Approved_SystemId_List') | summarize make_list(UAVId));
UAVSwarmComms_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where MessageType == "member_roster"
| extend TrulyUnknownMembers = set_difference(UnknownMemberIds, KnownSystemIdsArr)
| where MemberCountObserved > MemberCountExpected or array_length(TrulyUnknownMembers) > 0
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("Sybil위장멤버주입_기대:", tostring(MemberCountExpected), "_관측:", tostring(MemberCountObserved), "_미확인멤버:", tostring(TrulyUnknownMembers))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, SwarmId, MemberId, UAVId, MessageType, MemberCountExpected, MemberCountObserved, TrulyUnknownMembers, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S105 - Sybil Member Injection into Swarm - {{UAVId}}
